About us

The duo behind the camera.

Hey guys! We're a couple of four years with a ton of experience in the UGC space and we just moved into our first apartment together in St. Pete with our tuxedo cat, Ollie.

We both create full time, hit the gym regularly, and Molly teaches Pilates on the side. Brian has been creating for over two years and runs his own UGC agency, while Molly has been at it for over a year, so together we bring a ton of hands-on experience to every shoot.

Why it worked

The product became part of the entertainment instead of interrupting it. Familiar couple dynamics, natural chemistry, and humor created an immediate “that's literally us” reaction — driving shares and engagement while introducing Erly organically.
